_provenance.what: Every published ARC-3 human replay guid linked from the public blog post 'ARC-AGI-3 human dataset' (https://arcprize.org/blog/arc-agi-3-human-dataset), with the run metadata each one's /api/sessions/<guid> document reports.
_provenance.why: Plan docs/trace-findings/2026-09-14-decision-step-corpus-v0-plan.md §5 asked step 3 to count additional published guids and braced for zero; §7(a) calls scraping more guids 'step zero of any real corpus'. This is that count, committed rather than left in a chat message.
_provenance.collected: 2026-09-15 by tools/replay_scrape.py's /api/sessions client (one request per guid, 250 total).
caveats: 250 guids is NOT 250 gold episodes. tags is ['human'] on all 250, which covers losses too: 139 WIN, 70 GAME_OVER, 41 NOT_FINISHED.
These are the blog's 'Top 10 Replays' per environment, so they are a curated best-of, not a random sample of human play.

For v0's two target games specifically the additional wins are thin: of the 250, bp35-0a0ad940 has 1 WIN and g50t-5849a774 has 3 WIN — four more human wins between them, not twenty. The other 135 wins are on the remaining 23 environments.
The two replays the corpus already had (bp35 c935ca1b-..., g50t 4f0689d0-...) are NOT in this set. These were published 2026-03-22; ours 2026-09-14.

The blog's table header calls the link text 'score', but it matches levels_completed on 249 of 250 rows (the exception is guid 01e79bb8-4697-45c2-9bde-8de3b8c25169, link text 9 vs levels_completed 10). levels_completed here comes from /api/sessions, not from the blog.
One blog post was probed. It was not checked for pagination and no paginated or downloadable form of this list was found; see the README for what else was probed.
No recording was downloaded for any of these 250. Only /api/sessions was called.

fields.game_id: from /api/sessions environments[].runs[].id — needed to build the recordings URL
fields.actions: total actions in the run, from /api/sessions
fields.blog_link_text: the anchor text on the blog table, kept verbatim for traceability
